input_template: Configure a modflow prediction case for multilayer_confined: Multi-layer confined aquifer system with interbedded aquitards; n_layers >= 2. Remaining physical or categorical settings are C_concentration (contaminant concentration (used in transport scenarios, zero otherwise)) is {value_10} mg/L; D_dispersion, representing hydrodynamic dispersion coefficient (used in transport scenarios, zero otherwise), is set to {value_11} m²/d after being at 1/8 of nominal; lambda_decay = {value_12} 1/d for first-order contaminant decay constant (zero for flow-only scenarios); effective porosity (phi_porosity) takes {value_13}; rho_density (fluid density (used in variable-density scenarios, otherwise 1000)) is {value_14} kg/m³. Use monthly (day 15 of each month), 12 time points; observed channels: well 1, well 2, well 3, well 4, well 5 (5 of 5) and predict hydraulic_head.
target_template: Model output for hydraulic_head:{output_0}
